signature.one_line: Single locked-off standing take carried only by progressive word-by-word captions that fade in white on the chest; credential-stack hook and spoken numbered signposts.
unique_devices: Opacity-ramp word reveal: each word fades 0 -> 0.73 over 6 frames then snaps to 1.0 on frame 7, so the word being spoken reads as dim grey for a moment; layout pre-fixed so earlier words never move

Top-anchored caption block: first line's ink top fixed at 61.0 % height on the speaker's dark top, a second line grows downward (pitch 3.1 % H); white bold grotesque 50 px with a thin ~2 px near-black outline, no box
Phrase hand-off rhythm: the finished phrase hard-cuts out, the band stays empty ~4 frames, then the next phrase's first word fades in
Zero-edit thigh-up standing take in a bare room; structure comes only from a credential-stack hook and spoken 'Number N' signposts every ~15-20 % of runtime
signature.why_it_works: Stacked credentials plus a failure twist earn authority in seconds; the progressive reveal keeps eyes on the words while a fast, pause-light delivery and numbered signposts carry an uncut take.

hook.first_frame: thigh-up wide shot of the speaker standing centred in a bright bare room, gesturing; first caption word fading in on the chest at ~61 % height

structure.what: four quick credentials, then a vulnerable failure twist
current authority + the question the talk answers + one authority line
points 1-2, each opened with a spoken numbered signpost; insider reject criteria
point 3 answers the viewer's obvious objection with a worked example
points 4-5 with a stat and a direct instruction
optimistic payoff line and a one-word sign-off; no CTA

pacing.note: one continuous take (median shot = full runtime); the only visual change is the caption phrase (4-6 words) swapping roughly every 40-45 frames

captions.what: progressive word-by-word caption block, 1-7 words over max 2 lines
captions.how: Inter-ExtraBold-like 50 px white, ~2 px near-black outline, no box; centred, first-line ink top at 61.0 % H, line pitch 60 px, grows downward, max line 55 % W; per-word opacity ramp over 6 frames then snap to full on frame 7, 2-9 frames after the word; phrase hard-cuts out, ~4 empty frames

cards_lists.how: each point opens with a spoken 'Number N' signpost; nothing on screen marks it

layout.how: speaker centred, generous headroom, dark top so the white captions sit on it

camera.how: tripod, no punch-ins or digital moves; motion only from gestures

case.caption: sentence case as spoken (capital only at a sentence start)

grouping.sync: word-by-word: each word appears as it is spoken into a phrase layout that is fixed in advance (later words do not re-centre earlier ones)
grouping.break: phrase ends at a clause / line-full; the whole phrase hard-cuts out, ~4 frames empty, then the next phrase's first word fades in

caption.anchor: top-anchored: a second line grows downward

layout.on_1080x1920: same 9:16 canvas: first-line ink top at y 1171 px, line pitch 60 px, centred at x 540 px

caption.font_class: neo-grotesque / grotesque sans, bold-extra-bold (double-storey a, single-storey g, straight-tailed y, wide round o/e)

closest_match.google: Inter ExtraBold (alt: Figtree Bold / Plus Jakarta Sans Bold)

caption.k_note: a line with ascenders and descenders -> k 0.99: 2.42 x 19.2 / 0.99 = 47 px; cross-check on a line without descenders (k 0.73): 1.88 x 19.2 / 0.73 = 49 px; render-verified with Inter 800: 50 px
caption.calibration_note: measured on a one-line and a two-line phrase over a dark grey t-shirt (white ink isolated cleanly); lines with descenders 2.42 % H, without 1.88 % H
caption.color: #FFFFFF (spoken, settled); mid-fade words read as dim grey because they are semi-transparent white
caption.stroke: thin dark outline ~1 px at 720p (≈2 px at 1920), near-black, hugging the letters
caption.shadow: none beyond the outline (no blurred drop shadow measured)

animation.entry: per word: opacity ramps 0 -> 0.11 -> 0.20 -> 0.30 -> 0.41 -> 0.57 -> 0.73 over 6 frames, then snaps to 1.0 on frame 7; no scale, no slide, no blur
animation.timing: each word starts fading in 2-9 frames after its transcript start
animation.highlight: none (no colour change once settled; the dim-grey look is only the fade)
animation.exit: the whole phrase hard-cuts out (1 frame), the band stays empty ~4 frames, then the next phrase begins

other_text_spec.type: titles / cards / lower-thirds / stickers / end card
other_text_spec.text: none: one locked-off take; the captions are the only added layer

style.look_intent: mid-contrast, muted, warm-leaning natural daylight in a bright bare room; flat, ungraded look

sound.music: voice only (no bed detected; speech gaps sit ~39 dB below speech); lav-mic dry voice

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: the user has one long uncut advice take and wants captions as the only edit
the script is a numbered list of tips with spoken signposts
the speaker wears a dark top that gives the chest-level white captions contrast
a calm, readable, distraction-free caption style is preferred over flashy emphasis
avoid_when: fast short-form pacing is required (no cuts at all here)
the speaker wears white or light clothing at chest height
there are products, screens or b-roll to show
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B35 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B35.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps. All positions are % of frame; px are at 1080x1920.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} must stay >= 4.5:1 on the speaker's top where it sits, with the thin dark outline)
- {{TEXT}}      caption words                          default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}}    none (no highlight colour; the dim look is only the fade)  default none
- {{ACCENT_2}}  caption outline                        default near-black (#111111)
- {{SURFACE}}   none                                   default none
- {{CARD_BG}}   none                                   default none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} captions                            default Inter 800 (bold grotesque; alt Figtree Bold / Plus Jakarta Sans Bold)
- {{FONT_BODY}}    same as display                     default Inter 800
- {{HANDLE}}    not shown
- {{LOGO}}      not shown

CAPTIONS
1. English as spoken, sentence case (capital at a sentence start); keep commas, full stops, apostrophes.
2. Phrases of up to ~7 words over at most 2 centred lines, max line width ~55 % W (~595 px). Lay out the whole phrase first (line breaks and centring fixed), then reveal word by word as spoken; earlier words never move.
3. Type: {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 50 px, line pitch 60 px, tracking 0, {{TEXT}}, thin {{ACCENT_2}} outline ~2 px (paint-order stroke or a 1 px 4-direction text-shadow), no blurred shadow, no box.
4. Position: centred; the first line's ink top fixed at 61.0 % of height (y ~1171 px): one line centres at 62.2 %, a second line grows downward (centre 63.7 %). Keep it on the speaker's chest / dark clothing.
5. Per-word animation: opacity 0 -> 0.11 -> 0.20 -> 0.30 -> 0.41 -> 0.57 -> 0.73 over 6 frames, then snap to 1.0 on frame 7 (ease-in); start 2-9 frames after the word's transcript start. No scale, slide or blur. When the phrase is complete, cut it out on one frame, leave the band empty ~4 frames, then start the next phrase.
6. No colour highlight and no idle motion.

OTHER TEXT
7. None: no title, lower third, sticker, CTA card or end card.

EDIT DEVICES
8. Keep one locked-off thigh-up take; trim only head and tail. Script shape: credential stack + failure twist in the first ~5 % of runtime, the question by ~10 %, then numbered points with spoken signposts every ~15-20 % of runtime, one-word sign-off. (For a faster cut, add a punch-in every ~90-150 frames without moving the caption position.)

GRADE
9. Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: mid-contrast, muted, warm-leaning natural daylight; flat, ungraded feel.

AUDIO
10. Dry voice only, no music, no SFX; keep natural short pauses. Master to about -14.0 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render a test frame with a fully built one-line caption "KEY WORD" over a dark area and measure:
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test.mp4> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.2,0.585,0.8,0.67 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60"
b) Expected ink: video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py with {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 50 px (reference: lines with descenders 2.42 % H, without 1.88 % H). Required: within ±0.5 % H; first-line ink top at 61.0 % ±0.5; colour equal to {{TEXT}}. Check a mid-fade frame: the word at frame 6 of its ramp must read at ~73 % opacity.
